title: AssetRelation
description: One asset pointing at another, and what the pointing means. An edge rather than a column: an asset has no single related asset, and each kind of tie — one derived from another, one resembling another — would otherwise add a field to a thing it was never an attribute of.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

fromAsset.description: The id of the asset the tie starts at, in the system that owns it. The direction carries the meaning: derived_from read the other way is false.

toAsset.description: The id of the asset the tie points at, in the system that owns it.

relationType.description: What the tie means, in the words of whoever drew it. Free text: the vocabulary belongs to the system that relates them.
